entity: US counties flooded with opioid pills 2006-12 vs later overdose death rates
what_we_add: The 2.0x gap persisting into 2019-24 (fentanyl era), Knox County #27 of 1,832, Food City #674's 31% share of Knox's 30mg+ oxycodone
why: Washington Post 2019 states the same finding, same direction: death rates soared where pills flowed, top-pill counties 3x the national rate. Its window is the pill era; our 2019-24 persistence numbers and Knox specifics appear in no source.
